text: A Song, a Psalm of David. My heart{H3820} is fixed,{H3559} O God;{H430} I will sing,{H7891} yea, I will sing praises,{H2167} even with my glory.{H3519}
Awake,{H5782} psaltery{H5035} and harp:{H3658} I myself will awake{H5782} right early.{H7837}
I will give thanks{H3034} unto thee, O Jehovah,{H3068} among the peoples;{H5971} And I will sing praises{H2167} unto thee among the nations.{H3816}
For thy lovingkindness{H2617} is great{H1419} above the heavens;{H8064} And thy truth{H571} [reacheth] unto the skies.{H7834}
Be thou exalted,{H7311} O God,{H430} above the heavens,{H8064} And thy glory{H3519} above all the earth.{H776}
That thy beloved{H3039} may be delivered,{H2502} Save{H3467} with thy right hand,{H3225} and answer{H6030} us.
God{H430} hath spoken{H1696} in his holiness:{H6944} I will exult;{H5937} I will divide{H2505} Shechem,{H7927} and mete out{H4058} the valley{H6010} of Succoth.{H5523}
Gilead{H1568} is mine; Manasseh{H4519} is mine; Ephraim{H669} also is the defence{H4581} of my head;{H7218} Judah{H3063} is my sceptre.{H2710}
Moab{H4124} is my washpot;{H7366} Upon Edom{H123} will I cast{H7993} my shoe;{H5275} Over Philistia{H6429} will I shout.{H7321}
Who will bring{H2986} me into the fortified{H4013} city?{H5892} Who hath led{H5148} me unto Edom?{H123}
Hast not thou cast us off,{H2186} O God?{H430} And thou goest not forth,{H3318} O God,{H430} with our hosts.{H6635}
Give{H3051} us help{H5833} against the adversary;{H6862} For vain{H7723} is the help{H8668} of man.{H120}
Through God{H430} we shall do{H6213} valiantly:{H2428} For he it is that will tread down{H947} our adversaries.{H6862}
